lineClassifications.rawText: Use a centralized, versioned intake profile closed-loop-raw-units-zip-limits/1. Its bounds are: 27 cumulative central-directory entries across the entire selected input-version archive-mapping pass, including every supplied root and recursively decoded child; 67108864 bytes per expanded member; 70254592 cumulative reserved-or-produced expanded bytes; 140509184 cumulative archive bytes submitted to decoding (count a nested archive again when it is submitted); compression ratio at most 1100 per member; filename byte length at most 65535; canonical path depth at most 128; maximum archive nesting level 27 with the supplied archive at level 1; and one cumulative elapsed-worker deadline of 600000 ms for that entire input-version archive-mapping pass. The entry budget is charged on exposure before expansion, including unsupported/blocked entries; the maximum depth cannot bypass that budget. Expansion and byte accounting are checked before allocation and incrementally, against both declared and actual lengths; declared metadata never substitutes for verified bytes. The expansion safety counter reserves each declared output length before allocation; actual production within that reservation does not charge the same byte twice, while any additional produced byte must first fit and consume remaining budget. Every produced/reserved byte remains charged even if later CRC, validation or decoding fails; no refund, reset or retry can escape the pass-wide ceiling. It includes every child occurrence at every depth, including a nested archive's bytes as its parent's output and its own children separately. This work-safety counter is distinct from the semantic aggregate-byte review sum, which includes only actually verified retained child bytes. The archive-byte sum counts each archive occurrence once when submitted to decoding. The same original per-archive structural and byte checks remain; a bound can stop processing earlier, never authorize weaker checking. These ceilings reuse the current default decoder's 27 entries, 64 MiB file bound, 64 MiB + 1 MiB response + 2 MiB manifest total, twice-total archive bound, ratio/name/path/work bounds; the intake profile assigns those generic ceilings without granting any response.json/manifest.json role or larger filename-specific allowance. Transport recursiveExpansion=false and maxNestingDepth=0 remain response-transport rules, not intake accounting rules. A lower already-applicable storage/worker bound still stops work and remains explicitly blocked; it must not silently change this profile or yield favorable completeness. lineClassifications.rawText: JSON selector syntax is $ followed by zero or more .identifier, .*, [index], [*], or ['name'] segments. Delimiter and quote are distinct single Unicode scalars other than CR/LF; header is Boolean; encoding is UTF-8; newline is AUTO, LF, CRLF or CR. lineClassifications.rawText: PARSE_XML returns the document element as a canonical JSON object with exactly four required non-null properties: name (exact element-name string), attributes (object of exact parsed attribute-name/string-value pairs), children (ordered array of its immediate element-node values), and content (ordered array of strings and immediate element-node values in source content order). Every child appears once in children and once as the same canonical value in content; this is duplicated value content, not a cyclic pointer or identity-based equality. Each nonempty ordinary text run between markup boundaries contributes one decoded string; each nonempty CDATA body contributes one literal string. Empty runs are omitted, comments contribute no entry, adjacent strings separated by comment/CDATA boundaries are not coalesced, and entity references within a text run are decoded into that one string. Outside-root whitespace and the declaration are not represented. Attribute order has no canonical-equality significance; child/content array order and text-run segmentation do. Thus differently ordered attributes with equal values compare equal, while mixed text/child content remains observable in exact document order. XML name/attribute/character normalization is precisely the parsing rule above, not namespace inference.

lineClassifications.rawText: Accepted authoring forms are (1) records.tests[i].fields.EXPECTED_VARIANCE_CONTRACT, an embedded object with those lower-camel-case names, and (2) records.expectedVarianceContracts[i].fields.DIMENSIONS, .ALLOWED_VARIANCE and optional .RATIONALE, with TEST_ID in that record's relationships member. The latter is exactly relationships.TEST_ID = {"tempKey":"<same-response tests tempKey>"} or {"recordId":"<operation-supplied current tests ID>"}, resolved through the existing ingestion path. No direct authored application-owned TEST_ID field is accepted. Map only those three direct names to their lower-camel-case counterparts. Embedded additional canonical-JSON properties are preserved exactly and included in the semantic hash as nonoperative context; they cannot introduce executable meaning, a gate, evidence basis or favorable outcome. Direct records remain subject to their closed family registry; no arbitrary new direct field is permitted. If both forms address a test, their normalized objects must be canonical-byte-identical; disagreement or ambiguous duplicates block rather than choosing a winner. Byte-identical embedded and direct forms for the same resolved test produce exactly one current enclosing contract retaining provenance from both sources, never competing canonical contracts. Section 35.10 continues to require preservation of original extension bytes where available and default prompt exclusion. Hashing retained context establishes identity and invalidation only, never permission to execute it or to count it as favorable evidence.

- HUMAN_DECISION commands are CAPTURE_DELIVERY_INTENT; application confirmation of a newly reported human-origin answer; and RECORD_HUMAN_DECISION, one global application-validated command bound to exactly one registered purpose and target per invocation. The closed RECORD_HUMAN_DECISION purpose enum is INTENT_CONFIRMATION, CANDIDATE_COMPONENT_SELECTION, BASELINE_AUTHORIZATION, DISCLOSURE_AUTHORIZATION, EXTERNAL_ACTION_RISK_AUTHORIZATION, CONTROLLED_EXCEPTION, REGRESSION_RETIREMENT_AUTHORIZATION, BACKUP_POLICY_SELECTION, TRADEOFF_OR_SCOPE_DECISION, VISUAL_BASELINE_AUTHORIZATION, and HUMAN_AUTHORITY_CORRECTION. Each purpose writes only the humanDecisions record and the human-decision-owned fields FIELD_REGISTRY declares for that purpose and target. HUMAN commands are SAVE_HUMAN_INPUT, which creates and edits User Job Input and saves Section 18 fallback answers with their declared consequences, and RECORD_HUMAN_OBSERVATION, which records human-owned observation and evidence records for human-inspection routes. These commands write only their declared HUMAN or HUMAN_DECISION fields and records, accept no agent-owned canonical fields, and accept no external response envelope.

- BOOLEAN
- NUMBER
- CHOICE
- MULTI_CHOICE
- DATE
- FILE_REFERENCE

1. create a new User Job Input version;
2. invalidate the old prompt;
3. invalidate the old proposal;
4. recalculate state;
5. generate a replacement prompt for the same stage;
6. require a new current response.

primarySourceLocation.controllingText: For SAVE_HUMAN_INPUT, an absent/null/empty-string answer, or an empty MULTI_CHOICE array, is unanswered; a blocking request rejects it. A nonmissing TEXT or LONG_TEXT answer is a nonblank string; BOOLEAN is Boolean; NUMBER is either a JSON safe integer other than negative zero, or a string rational:N/D where N is a nonzero signed base-10 integer with no plus or leading zeros, D is a positive base-10 integer with no leading zeros, and gcd(abs(N),D)=1. D=1 is permitted only when N is outside the JSON safe-integer range. Zero is represented only by JSON integer 0. Other strings and typed objects are rejected; saving preserves this canonical representation; CHOICE is one exact allowed string; MULTI_CHOICE is an ordered duplicate-free array of exact allowed strings; DATE is a valid Gregorian calendar date in four-digit YYYY-MM-DD form with year 0001–9999, validated without time-zone conversion; FILE_REFERENCE is one current canonical artifact ID in the same project. Optional unanswered requests confer no factual assertion. Successful saving has precisely the existing §18 invalidation and replacement consequences.

It is one immutable owning-record-to-proofExpressions relationship, with no default. Its producer, scope, writable operation and invalidation owner follow the owning record's existing proposal/acceptance contract; the APPLICATION alone resolves and installs the canonical relationship. It is stored on that existing record, not in a new family.

The application derives DUE_NOW only when the current stage is at least EARLIEST_EXECUTABLE_STAGE, the target-availability condition is TRUE, the obligation is current and applicable, and the current stage is at or beyond its REQUIRED_BY_STAGE. UNKNOWN target availability blocks only when the obligation could be due.

Stages 12, 13, 18, and 19 evaluate only current applicable PREPRODUCT_ITERATION obligations whose PER_RUN_REQUIRED value is TRUE and that are due by the relevant stage. Final-product, representation, delivery, evidence-closure, registry-closure, and terminal-delivery obligations do not block Stage 18 or Stage 19 before their targets exist, and Stages 12, 13, 18, and 19 MUST NOT require product-only, representation-only, delivery-only, or terminal-only propositions before their targets exist. They remain preserved as future required obligations and become due at their declared stages.

A deferred target-dependent test becomes due no earlier than the first stage where its target exists and no later than REQUIRED_BY_STAGE. It is never required before the target exists and is never represented as executed before actual execution.

The closed proof-expression language permits LEAF, ALL_OF, ANY_OF, and AT_LEAST_K only. It has no arbitrary code, unrestricted negation, implicit coercion, stale references, or empty operators. ALL_OF is TRUE when all children are TRUE, FALSE when any is FALSE, and UNKNOWN otherwise. ANY_OF is TRUE when any is TRUE, FALSE when all are FALSE, and UNKNOWN otherwise. AT_LEAST_K is TRUE when trueCount ≥ K, FALSE when trueCount + unknownCount < K, and UNKNOWN otherwise.

Every current applicable release-bearing proposition has exactly one current PROOF_OBLIGATION_ID identifying its proof expression, required leaves, evidence classes, allowed epistemic bases, artifacts, dependencies, freshness, independence, verification timing, current satisfaction, blockers, and scope hash. Optional, advisory, stale, historical, or unregistered results cannot satisfy it.

EQUIVALENT applies only to proposition-to-proposition sameness. The relation between a test and a proof leaf, and between a proof expression and its proposition, is sufficiency, established by the accepted Stage 06 PROOF_REVIEW. A LEAF references exactly one of: a canonical test with its required disposition, an observation-backed proposition, an applicability or activation condition, or a prerequisite proof obligation; each leaf declares its truth extraction, required evidence classes, and scope binding, and no other leaf target is valid in version 1. An ANY_OF expression is accepted only when the review establishes that each branch alone suffices to establish the parent proposition; an AT_LEAST_K expression is accepted only when every permitted K-combination suffices or an explicitly reviewed combinatorial sufficiency contract covers it. A branch that weakens proof strength is rejected at Stage 06.

29.14 Observation, entailment, origin, and freshness

Every release-bearing evidence path is EVIDENCE_RECORD → OBSERVATION_RECORD → proposition or proof leaf. An observation identifies exact subject, location or measurement point, finding, method/tool, inputs and outputs, hashes, origin, submitting actor, epistemic basis, time/freshness fields, source evidence, scope, and raw-response or native-execution provenance.

Every observation has an accepted relation ESTABLISHES, REFUTES, SUPPORTS_ONLY, CONTEXT_ONLY, DOES_NOT_ADDRESS, or UNKNOWN. Only ESTABLISHES provides affirmative proof; REFUTES provides failure evidence; SUPPORTS_ONLY and CONTEXT_ONLY cannot independently satisfy a proof obligation. Normalization never elevates an external claim.

Time-sensitive evidence records observedAt, its DEVICE_REPORTED, SOURCE_ASSERTED, or VERIFIED_EXTERNAL basis, validFrom, validUntil, supersession, freshness requirement, status, and reason. Required freshness that cannot be established is UNKNOWN. Current justificatory evidence is acyclic.

VERIFIED_EXTERNAL is achieved only under a registered attestation-verification contract fixing the evidence type, the attesting tool or system identity, the verification method, the bound inputs including the operation challengeNonce or reservation, the freshness rule, and the failure semantics. Absent such a registered contract, the basis remains EXTERNALLY_SUPPORTED or weaker.

The authored form is records.<owning family>[i].fields.TARGET_AVAILABILITY_CONDITION = {"PROOF_EXPRESSION_ID": <reference>}. Here <reference> uses the existing response-local relationship convention: exactly {"tempKey":"<same-response proofExpressions tempKey>"} or {"recordId":"<current proofExpressions canonical ID supplied by the operation>"}, with no other keys, nulls or defaults. A tempKey must resolve uniquely to a proofExpressions proposal in the same response; a recordId must resolve to the correct current family, project and scope. The APPLICATION resolves this nested relationship through the single ingestion path and at proposal acceptance replaces <reference> with the allocated/resolved canonical ID string. Agents do not write the canonical string directly. This declares the nested relationship's placement, not a second ingestion path.

The application derives DUE_NOW only when the current stage is at least EARLIEST_EXECUTABLE_STAGE, the target-availability condition is TRUE, the obligation is current and applicable, and the current stage is at or beyond its REQUIRED_BY_STAGE. UNKNOWN target availability blocks only when the obligation could be due.

Stages 12, 13, 18, and 19 evaluate only current applicable PREPRODUCT_ITERATION obligations whose PER_RUN_REQUIRED value is TRUE and that are due by the relevant stage. Final-product, representation, delivery, evidence-closure, registry-closure, and terminal-delivery obligations do not block Stage 18 or Stage 19 before their targets exist, and Stages 12, 13, 18, and 19 MUST NOT require product-only, representation-only, delivery-only, or terminal-only propositions before their targets exist. They remain preserved as future required obligations and become due at their declared stages.

A deferred target-dependent test becomes due no earlier than the first stage where its target exists and no later than REQUIRED_BY_STAGE. It is never required before the target exists and is never represented as executed before actual execution.

The closed proof-expression language permits LEAF, ALL_OF, ANY_OF, and AT_LEAST_K only. It has no arbitrary code, unrestricted negation, implicit coercion, stale references, or empty operators. ALL_OF is TRUE when all children are TRUE, FALSE when any is FALSE, and UNKNOWN otherwise. ANY_OF is TRUE when any is TRUE, FALSE when all are FALSE, and UNKNOWN otherwise. AT_LEAST_K is TRUE when trueCount ≥ K, FALSE when trueCount + unknownCount < K, and UNKNOWN otherwise.

Every current applicable release-bearing proposition has exactly one current PROOF_OBLIGATION_ID identifying its proof expression, required leaves, evidence classes, allowed epistemic bases, artifacts, dependencies, freshness, independence, verification timing, current satisfaction, blockers, and scope hash. Optional, advisory, stale, historical, or unregistered results cannot satisfy it.

EQUIVALENT applies only to proposition-to-proposition sameness. The relation between a test and a proof leaf, and between a proof expression and its proposition, is sufficiency, established by the accepted Stage 06 PROOF_REVIEW. A LEAF references exactly one of: a canonical test with its required disposition, an observation-backed proposition, an applicability or activation condition, or a prerequisite proof obligation; each leaf declares its truth extraction, required evidence classes, and scope binding, and no other leaf target is valid in version 1. An ANY_OF expression is accepted only when the review establishes that each branch alone suffices to establish the parent proposition; an AT_LEAST_K expression is accepted only when every permitted K-combination suffices or an explicitly reviewed combinatorial sufficiency contract covers it. A branch that weakens proof strength is rejected at Stage 06.

29.14 Observation, entailment, origin, and freshness

Every release-bearing evidence path is EVIDENCE_RECORD → OBSERVATION_RECORD → proposition or proof leaf. An observation identifies exact subject, location or measurement point, finding, method/tool, inputs and outputs, hashes, origin, submitting actor, epistemic basis, time/freshness fields, source evidence, scope, and raw-response or native-execution provenance.

Every observation has an accepted relation ESTABLISHES, REFUTES, SUPPORTS_ONLY, CONTEXT_ONLY, DOES_NOT_ADDRESS, or UNKNOWN. Only ESTABLISHES provides affirmative proof; REFUTES provides failure evidence; SUPPORTS_ONLY and CONTEXT_ONLY cannot independently satisfy a proof obligation. Normalization never elevates an external claim.

Time-sensitive evidence records observedAt, its DEVICE_REPORTED, SOURCE_ASSERTED, or VERIFIED_EXTERNAL basis, validFrom, validUntil, supersession, freshness requirement, status, and reason. Required freshness that cannot be established is UNKNOWN. Current justificatory evidence is acyclic.

VERIFIED_EXTERNAL is achieved only under a registered attestation-verification contract fixing the evidence type, the attesting tool or system identity, the verification method, the bound inputs including the operation challengeNonce or reservation, the freshness rule, and the failure semantics. Absent such a registered contract, the basis remains EXTERNALLY_SUPPORTED or weaker.

contextSourceLocations.controllingText: C. Insert after §6.5A: normative algorithm closed-loop-raw-units/1

The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

Raw-input accounting MUST use one versioned RAW_UNITIZATION_VERSION — current value closed-loop-raw-units/1 — with deterministic media-specific unit rules. Text-message boundaries, structured text units, document pages and sections where mechanically available, archive members, embedded documents, native images and media, unsupported-format whole-file fallbacks, and source locations receive stable application-owned unit identities.

The unitization contract explicitly defines treatment of comments, annotations, tracked changes, metadata, embedded objects, inaccessible content, and unsupported formats. A supported subdivision cannot be replaced by one whole-file unit merely to make coverage vacuous. SEMANTIC_CHALLENGE_LIMITS/1 triggers a challenge when any one of these thresholds is exceeded: 1,048,576 stored bytes in one text or document artifact; 100 mechanically countable pages; 20 supplied files or archive members; 500 raw units; or 5,242,880 aggregate supplied bytes. A material uncovered unit, broad exclusion, INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED material, material uncertainty, contradiction, or operator request triggers regardless of size. These limits are centralized, versioned, and acceptance-tested and may be lowered but not raised without a new contract-profile identity.

Every normalizer and application derivation has an immutable registry ID, version, implementation-owner file, canonical input contract, output contract, hash or build identity, and invalidation consequences. Every derived value records the exact derivation ID and source-record hashes. A changed normalizer or derivation invalidates affected current values and results unless an explicit compatibility migration proves byte- and semantic-equivalent output.

Every release-bearing derivation and normalizer is completely defined by this specification or by an explicitly named versioned normative algorithm. The semantics defined in Sections 14.6, 15, 16.1, 26, 29, 30, 31, 34.1, 34.2, and 36 control their registry entries, and an entry cannot deviate from them. A release-bearing derivation or normalizer whose semantics are not so defined is UNDEFINED_DERIVATION and blocks acceptance.

obligations.statement: For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit.

primarySourceLocation.controllingText: For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

C. Insert after §6.5A: normative algorithm closed-loop-raw-units/1

The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

For a mechanically supported structured-media subdivision, emit one structural unit per exposed page, section, archive member, embedded document/object, comment, annotation, tracked change or metadata object, using its exact parent and source locator; traverse children in source order, breaking any absent source-order tie by unsigned Unicode-scalar locator order. Recurse into textual leaves using the physical-content rule and into child media using this rule. A structural node is counted once per occurrence/location/kind; a node's structural unit and its descendant content units are distinct. Preserve inaccessible exposed nodes as INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED; do not fabricate children. Detailed coverage requires a closed format mapping that is part of this named versioned normative algorithm or an explicitly identified versioned normative format mapping authorized under §34.3. Merely publishing an implementation descriptor does not authorize such semantics. The mapping must fix node kinds, source locators, ordering, exact canonical source values and child extraction. This insertion adds no format-specific adapter or mapping. A claim of supported detailed coverage without that normative mapping is blocked; genuinely unsupported formats retain the fallback below. A mechanically available subdivision cannot be suppressed or relabeled unsupported to avoid that blocker.

Subdivision is additive: an exact UTF-8 whole-file projection emits its physical spans even when a supported structured mapping also emits structural nodes and textual leaves. Whole-file spans, structural nodes and structural textual-leaf spans have distinct kinds and locators and are all counted; overlap in underlying bytes does not deduplicate these different accounting obligations. Each archive-member or embedded-file occurrence emits both its parent structural occurrence unit and its own child inventory unit, followed by its own supported content/subdivisions. A textual leaf is not a child file and gets no inventory unit. Repeated references to the same emitted unit still deduplicate under the rule below.

Source hashes and binding are closed as follows. C(x) means the exact UTF-8 bytes of §34.1 canonical JSON; H(b) means lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal of exact bytes b. Source-value hash preimages by kind are:

- ARTIFACT_INVENTORY: C({"byteLength":n,"contentSha256":h}), where n is exact byte length and h=H(exact artifact bytes). If bytes are unavailable, both values are null; asserted length/digest remains source context, never substituted for observed bytes. The unit remains inaccessible/blocked, with its retained occurrence/locator binding.

- PHYSICAL_SPAN: the exact original byte span including its terminator, without canonical JSON wrapping. Its locator binds zero-based byte start and exclusive end plus the one-based page/line coordinates.

- STRUCTURAL_NODE: C({"nodeKind":k,"status":q,"value":v}), where k and v are the exact kind and canonical source value fixed by the authorized format mapping, and q is ACCESSIBLE or INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED. Inaccessible nodes have v=null; exact exposed parent/locator and k remain bound. No invented serialization of an adapter object is permitted.

- STRUCTURAL_TEXT_SPAN: exact UTF-8 bytes of the mapped exact textual leaf's physical span, including its terminator. The authorized mapping identifies the leaf and its exact extraction; no silent whitespace normalization is allowed.

Each unit's binding hash preimage is C({"algorithm":"closed-loop-raw-units/1","inputVersion":V,"occurrence":O,"kind":K,"locator":L,"sourceValueSha256":S}). V is the exact owning input-version identity string; O is the ordered zero-based safe-integer path of supplied root and, where applicable, child-member occurrence indices; K is exactly one of the seven uppercase kinds above; S is the corresponding source-value hash. L is an ordered locator array: human units use [originating JSON pointer, one-based physical line] or [originating JSON pointer] for whole strings/scalars; inventories use []; whole-file spans use [startByte,endByte,page,line]; structural nodes use [normative format mapping ID, exact mapping locator]; structural textual spans append [startByte,endByte,page,line] to their structural-leaf locator. Byte offsets for a structural textual leaf refer to its exact UTF-8 extraction. The source-value hash alone does not identify the occurrence: binding hash plus retained input/source supplies the exact type, location and occurrence. These accounting hashes/locators are not §34.2 canonical record IDs. Distinct roots are numbered in retained source occurrence order, including separately supplied identical roots; a canonical mirror does not receive a second root number.

An image/media occurrence without a supported finer subdivision uses its inventory unit as its whole-media unit. A format with no supported mechanically available subdivision likewise uses its inventory unit as the whole-file fallback, with an explicit unsupported/unavailable-subdivision basis and the original bytes retained. These fallbacks neither prove inspection nor remove existing material uncertainty/blockers. Comments, annotations, tracked changes, metadata and embedded content are not discarded as nonsemantic.

The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. For a mechanically supported structured-media subdivision, emit one structural unit per exposed page, section, archive member, embedded document/object, comment, annotation, tracked change or metadata object, using its exact parent and source locator; traverse children in source order, breaking any absent source-order tie by unsigned Unicode-scalar locator order. Subdivision is additive: an exact UTF-8 whole-file projection emits its physical spans even when a supported structured mapping also emits structural nodes and textual leaves. Source hashes and binding are closed as follows. C(x) means the exact UTF-8 bytes of §34.1 canonical JSON; H(b) means lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal of exact bytes b. Source-value hash preimages by kind are:

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. C. Insert after §6.5A: normative algorithm closed-loop-raw-units/1

The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

For a mechanically supported structured-media subdivision, emit one structural unit per exposed page, section, archive member, embedded document/object, comment, annotation, tracked change or metadata object, using its exact parent and source locator; traverse children in source order, breaking any absent source-order tie by unsigned Unicode-scalar locator order. Recurse into textual leaves using the physical-content rule and into child media using this rule. A structural node is counted once per occurrence/location/kind; a node's structural unit and its descendant content units are distinct. Preserve inaccessible exposed nodes as INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED; do not fabricate children. Detailed coverage requires a closed format mapping that is part of this named versioned normative algorithm or an explicitly identified versioned normative format mapping authorized under §34.3. Merely publishing an implementation descriptor does not authorize such semantics. The mapping must fix node kinds, source locators, ordering, exact canonical source values and child extraction. This insertion adds no format-specific adapter or mapping. A claim of supported detailed coverage without that normative mapping is blocked; genuinely unsupported formats retain the fallback below. A mechanically available subdivision cannot be suppressed or relabeled unsupported to avoid that blocker.

Subdivision is additive: an exact UTF-8 whole-file projection emits its physical spans even when a supported structured mapping also emits structural nodes and textual leaves. Whole-file spans, structural nodes and structural textual-leaf spans have distinct kinds and locators and are all counted; overlap in underlying bytes does not deduplicate these different accounting obligations. Each archive-member or embedded-file occurrence emits both its parent structural occurrence unit and its own child inventory unit, followed by its own supported content/subdivisions. A textual leaf is not a child file and gets no inventory unit. Repeated references to the same emitted unit still deduplicate under the rule below.

Source hashes and binding are closed as follows. C(x) means the exact UTF-8 bytes of §34.1 canonical JSON; H(b) means lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal of exact bytes b. Source-value hash preimages by kind are:

- ARTIFACT_INVENTORY: C({"byteLength":n,"contentSha256":h}), where n is exact byte length and h=H(exact artifact bytes). If bytes are unavailable, both values are null; asserted length/digest remains source context, never substituted for observed bytes. The unit remains inaccessible/blocked, with its retained occurrence/locator binding.

- PHYSICAL_SPAN: the exact original byte span including its terminator, without canonical JSON wrapping. Its locator binds zero-based byte start and exclusive end plus the one-based page/line coordinates.

- STRUCTURAL_NODE: C({"nodeKind":k,"status":q,"value":v}), where k and v are the exact kind and canonical source value fixed by the authorized format mapping, and q is ACCESSIBLE or INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED. Inaccessible nodes have v=null; exact exposed parent/locator and k remain bound. No invented serialization of an adapter object is permitted.

- STRUCTURAL_TEXT_SPAN: exact UTF-8 bytes of the mapped exact textual leaf's physical span, including its terminator. The authorized mapping identifies the leaf and its exact extraction; no silent whitespace normalization is allowed.

Each unit's binding hash preimage is C({"algorithm":"closed-loop-raw-units/1","inputVersion":V,"occurrence":O,"kind":K,"locator":L,"sourceValueSha256":S}). V is the exact owning input-version identity string; O is the ordered zero-based safe-integer path of supplied root and, where applicable, child-member occurrence indices; K is exactly one of the seven uppercase kinds above; S is the corresponding source-value hash. L is an ordered locator array: human units use [originating JSON pointer, one-based physical line] or [originating JSON pointer] for whole strings/scalars; inventories use []; whole-file spans use [startByte,endByte,page,line]; structural nodes use [normative format mapping ID, exact mapping locator]; structural textual spans append [startByte,endByte,page,line] to their structural-leaf locator. Byte offsets for a structural textual leaf refer to its exact UTF-8 extraction. The source-value hash alone does not identify the occurrence: binding hash plus retained input/source supplies the exact type, location and occurrence. These accounting hashes/locators are not §34.2 canonical record IDs. Distinct roots are numbered in retained source occurrence order, including separately supplied identical roots; a canonical mirror does not receive a second root number.

An image/media occurrence without a supported finer subdivision uses its inventory unit as its whole-media unit. A format with no supported mechanically available subdivision likewise uses its inventory unit as the whole-file fallback, with an explicit unsupported/unavailable-subdivision basis and the original bytes retained. These fallbacks neither prove inspection nor remove existing material uncertainty/blockers. Comments, annotations, tracked changes, metadata and embedded content are not discarded as nonsemantic.

Deduplicate only repeated accounting references to the same occurrence, kind, location and exact source-value hash. Never merge distinct supplied occurrences, even with identical hashes. Order and retained source identity determine stable accounting references; canonical record IDs still use §34.2. Count the entire resulting unit universe, including inventory, structural and inaccessible units, when applying the unchanged §6.5A limits. The raw-unit challenge condition is strictly greater than 500, not greater than or equal to 500; every other size-independent trigger remains effective.

Noncandidate bytes without a ZIP claim do not receive ZIP nodes through speculation; C's other available accounting rules remain applicable.

Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

For a mechanically supported structured-media subdivision, emit one structural unit per exposed page, section, archive member, embedded document/object, comment, annotation, tracked change or metadata object, using its exact parent and source locator; traverse children in source order, breaking any absent source-order tie by unsigned Unicode-scalar locator order. Recognition and bounded decoding

Every artifact preserves rawFilename and has a safe displayFilename and canonicalPath under closed-loop-filename/1. Canonical comparison uses Unicode 15.1.0 NFC, case-sensitive identity, and separately checked Unicode 15.1.0 default-case-fold and registered platform-risk collision keys. Absolute paths, drive prefixes, NUL, control characters, empty segments, `.` and `..`, duplicate canonical paths, case-fold collisions, extraction-target collisions, and supported confusable collisions are rejected. An unauthorized rename never matches solely because bytes are equal.

File extension and browser MIME type are claims. Format-dependent work records the authorized parser or adapter and detected interpretation. A materially ambiguous polyglot is BLOCKED unless one interpretation is explicitly authorized and every alternate interpretation is harmless under the operation.

Archive intake and export fail closed on traversal, absolute paths, duplicate or colliding paths, symlinks, hard links, device entries, unsupported special files, unsupported or encrypted members outside a registered encrypted contract, unsupported compression, excessive nesting, entry count, per-entry size, total compressed or expanded size, compression ratio, path depth, filename length, Unicode ambiguity, manifest mismatch, unmanifested extra members, missing members, or modified bytes. Expansion occurs only in an isolated bounded parser path and never makes content executable or prompt-visible by itself.

Every normalizer and application derivation has an immutable registry ID, version, implementation-owner file, canonical input contract, output contract, hash or build identity, and invalidation consequences. Every derived value records the exact derivation ID and source-record hashes. A changed normalizer or derivation invalidates affected current values and results unless an explicit compatibility migration proves byte- and semantic-equivalent output.

Every release-bearing derivation and normalizer is completely defined by this specification or by an explicitly named versioned normative algorithm. The semantics defined in Sections 14.6, 15, 16.1, 26, 29, 30, 31, 34.1, 34.2, and 36 control their registry entries, and an entry cannot deviate from them. A release-bearing derivation or normalizer whose semantics are not so defined is UNDEFINED_DERIVATION and blocks acceptance.
C. Insert after §6.5A: normative algorithm closed-loop-raw-units/1

The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

For a mechanically supported structured-media subdivision, emit one structural unit per exposed page, section, archive member, embedded document/object, comment, annotation, tracked change or metadata object, using its exact parent and source locator; traverse children in source order, breaking any absent source-order tie by unsigned Unicode-scalar locator order. Recurse into textual leaves using the physical-content rule and into child media using this rule. A structural node is counted once per occurrence/location/kind; a node's structural unit and its descendant content units are distinct. Preserve inaccessible exposed nodes as INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED; do not fabricate children. Detailed coverage requires a closed format mapping that is part of this named versioned normative algorithm or an explicitly identified versioned normative format mapping authorized under §34.3. Merely publishing an implementation descriptor does not authorize such semantics. The mapping must fix node kinds, source locators, ordering, exact canonical source values and child extraction. This insertion adds no format-specific adapter or mapping. A claim of supported detailed coverage without that normative mapping is blocked; genuinely unsupported formats retain the fallback below. A mechanically available subdivision cannot be suppressed or relabeled unsupported to avoid that blocker.

Subdivision is additive: an exact UTF-8 whole-file projection emits its physical spans even when a supported structured mapping also emits structural nodes and textual leaves. Whole-file spans, structural nodes and structural textual-leaf spans have distinct kinds and locators and are all counted; overlap in underlying bytes does not deduplicate these different accounting obligations. Each archive-member or embedded-file occurrence emits both its parent structural occurrence unit and its own child inventory unit, followed by its own supported content/subdivisions. A textual leaf is not a child file and gets no inventory unit. Repeated references to the same emitted unit still deduplicate under the rule below.

Source hashes and binding are closed as follows. C(x) means the exact UTF-8 bytes of §34.1 canonical JSON; H(b) means lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal of exact bytes b. Source-value hash preimages by kind are:

- ARTIFACT_INVENTORY: C({"byteLength":n,"contentSha256":h}), where n is exact byte length and h=H(exact artifact bytes). If bytes are unavailable, both values are null; asserted length/digest remains source context, never substituted for observed bytes. The unit remains inaccessible/blocked, with its retained occurrence/locator binding.

- PHYSICAL_SPAN: the exact original byte span including its terminator, without canonical JSON wrapping. Its locator binds zero-based byte start and exclusive end plus the one-based page/line coordinates.

- STRUCTURAL_NODE: C({"nodeKind":k,"status":q,"value":v}), where k and v are the exact kind and canonical source value fixed by the authorized format mapping, and q is ACCESSIBLE or INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED. Inaccessible nodes have v=null; exact exposed parent/locator and k remain bound. No invented serialization of an adapter object is permitted.

- STRUCTURAL_TEXT_SPAN: exact UTF-8 bytes of the mapped exact textual leaf's physical span, including its terminator. The authorized mapping identifies the leaf and its exact extraction; no silent whitespace normalization is allowed.

Each unit's binding hash preimage is C({"algorithm":"closed-loop-raw-units/1","inputVersion":V,"occurrence":O,"kind":K,"locator":L,"sourceValueSha256":S}). V is the exact owning input-version identity string; O is the ordered zero-based safe-integer path of supplied root and, where applicable, child-member occurrence indices; K is exactly one of the seven uppercase kinds above; S is the corresponding source-value hash. L is an ordered locator array: human units use [originating JSON pointer, one-based physical line] or [originating JSON pointer] for whole strings/scalars; inventories use []; whole-file spans use [startByte,endByte,page,line]; structural nodes use [normative format mapping ID, exact mapping locator]; structural textual spans append [startByte,endByte,page,line] to their structural-leaf locator. Byte offsets for a structural textual leaf refer to its exact UTF-8 extraction. The source-value hash alone does not identify the occurrence: binding hash plus retained input/source supplies the exact type, location and occurrence. These accounting hashes/locators are not §34.2 canonical record IDs. Distinct roots are numbered in retained source occurrence order, including separately supplied identical roots; a canonical mirror does not receive a second root number.

An image/media occurrence without a supported finer subdivision uses its inventory unit as its whole-media unit. A format with no supported mechanically available subdivision likewise uses its inventory unit as the whole-file fallback, with an explicit unsupported/unavailable-subdivision basis and the original bytes retained. These fallbacks neither prove inspection nor remove existing material uncertainty/blockers. Comments, annotations, tracked changes, metadata and embedded content are not discarded as nonsemantic.

Deduplicate only repeated accounting references to the same occurrence, kind, location and exact source-value hash. Never merge distinct supplied occurrences, even with identical hashes. Order and retained source identity determine stable accounting references; canonical record IDs still use §34.2. Count the entire resulting unit universe, including inventory, structural and inaccessible units, when applying the unchanged §6.5A limits. The raw-unit challenge condition is strictly greater than 500, not greater than or equal to 500; every other size-independent trigger remains effective.

C. Insert after §6.5A: normative algorithm closed-loop-raw-units/1

The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

For a mechanically supported structured-media subdivision, emit one structural unit per exposed page, section, archive member, embedded document/object, comment, annotation, tracked change or metadata object, using its exact parent and source locator; traverse children in source order, breaking any absent source-order tie by unsigned Unicode-scalar locator order. Recurse into textual leaves using the physical-content rule and into child media using this rule. A structural node is counted once per occurrence/location/kind; a node's structural unit and its descendant content units are distinct. Preserve inaccessible exposed nodes as INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED; do not fabricate children. Detailed coverage requires a closed format mapping that is part of this named versioned normative algorithm or an explicitly identified versioned normative format mapping authorized under §34.3. Merely publishing an implementation descriptor does not authorize such semantics. The mapping must fix node kinds, source locators, ordering, exact canonical source values and child extraction. This insertion adds no format-specific adapter or mapping. A claim of supported detailed coverage without that normative mapping is blocked; genuinely unsupported formats retain the fallback below. A mechanically available subdivision cannot be suppressed or relabeled unsupported to avoid that blocker.

Subdivision is additive: an exact UTF-8 whole-file projection emits its physical spans even when a supported structured mapping also emits structural nodes and textual leaves. Whole-file spans, structural nodes and structural textual-leaf spans have distinct kinds and locators and are all counted; overlap in underlying bytes does not deduplicate these different accounting obligations. Each archive-member or embedded-file occurrence emits both its parent structural occurrence unit and its own child inventory unit, followed by its own supported content/subdivisions. A textual leaf is not a child file and gets no inventory unit. Repeated references to the same emitted unit still deduplicate under the rule below.

Source hashes and binding are closed as follows. C(x) means the exact UTF-8 bytes of §34.1 canonical JSON; H(b) means lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal of exact bytes b. Source-value hash preimages by kind are:

- ARTIFACT_INVENTORY: C({"byteLength":n,"contentSha256":h}), where n is exact byte length and h=H(exact artifact bytes). If bytes are unavailable, both values are null; asserted length/digest remains source context, never substituted for observed bytes. The unit remains inaccessible/blocked, with its retained occurrence/locator binding.

- PHYSICAL_SPAN: the exact original byte span including its terminator, without canonical JSON wrapping. Its locator binds zero-based byte start and exclusive end plus the one-based page/line coordinates.

- STRUCTURAL_NODE: C({"nodeKind":k,"status":q,"value":v}), where k and v are the exact kind and canonical source value fixed by the authorized format mapping, and q is ACCESSIBLE or INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED. Inaccessible nodes have v=null; exact exposed parent/locator and k remain bound. No invented serialization of an adapter object is permitted.

- STRUCTURAL_TEXT_SPAN: exact UTF-8 bytes of the mapped exact textual leaf's physical span, including its terminator. The authorized mapping identifies the leaf and its exact extraction; no silent whitespace normalization is allowed.

Each unit's binding hash preimage is C({"algorithm":"closed-loop-raw-units/1","inputVersion":V,"occurrence":O,"kind":K,"locator":L,"sourceValueSha256":S}). V is the exact owning input-version identity string; O is the ordered zero-based safe-integer path of supplied root and, where applicable, child-member occurrence indices; K is exactly one of the seven uppercase kinds above; S is the corresponding source-value hash. L is an ordered locator array: human units use [originating JSON pointer, one-based physical line] or [originating JSON pointer] for whole strings/scalars; inventories use []; whole-file spans use [startByte,endByte,page,line]; structural nodes use [normative format mapping ID, exact mapping locator]; structural textual spans append [startByte,endByte,page,line] to their structural-leaf locator. Byte offsets for a structural textual leaf refer to its exact UTF-8 extraction. The source-value hash alone does not identify the occurrence: binding hash plus retained input/source supplies the exact type, location and occurrence. These accounting hashes/locators are not §34.2 canonical record IDs. Distinct roots are numbered in retained source occurrence order, including separately supplied identical roots; a canonical mirror does not receive a second root number.

An image/media occurrence without a supported finer subdivision uses its inventory unit as its whole-media unit. A format with no supported mechanically available subdivision likewise uses its inventory unit as the whole-file fallback, with an explicit unsupported/unavailable-subdivision basis and the original bytes retained. These fallbacks neither prove inspection nor remove existing material uncertainty/blockers. Comments, annotations, tracked changes, metadata and embedded content are not discarded as nonsemantic.

Deduplicate only repeated accounting references to the same occurrence, kind, location and exact source-value hash. Never merge distinct supplied occurrences, even with identical hashes. Order and retained source identity determine stable accounting references; canonical record IDs still use §34.2. Count the entire resulting unit universe, including inventory, structural and inaccessible units, when applying the unchanged §6.5A limits. The raw-unit challenge condition is strictly greater than 500, not greater than or equal to 500; every other size-independent trigger remains effective.

primarySourceLocation.controllingText: Use a centralized, versioned intake profile closed-loop-raw-units-zip-limits/1. Its bounds are: 27 cumulative central-directory entries across the entire selected input-version archive-mapping pass, including every supplied root and recursively decoded child; 67108864 bytes per expanded member; 70254592 cumulative reserved-or-produced expanded bytes; 140509184 cumulative archive bytes submitted to decoding (count a nested archive again when it is submitted); compression ratio at most 1100 per member; filename byte length at most 65535; canonical path depth at most 128; maximum archive nesting level 27 with the supplied archive at level 1; and one cumulative elapsed-worker deadline of 600000 ms for that entire input-version archive-mapping pass. The entry budget is charged on exposure before expansion, including unsupported/blocked entries; the maximum depth cannot bypass that budget. Expansion and byte accounting are checked before allocation and incrementally, against both declared and actual lengths; declared metadata never substitutes for verified bytes. The expansion safety counter reserves each declared output length before allocation; actual production within that reservation does not charge the same byte twice, while any additional produced byte must first fit and consume remaining budget. Every produced/reserved byte remains charged even if later CRC, validation or decoding fails; no refund, reset or retry can escape the pass-wide ceiling. It includes every child occurrence at every depth, including a nested archive's bytes as its parent's output and its own children separately. This work-safety counter is distinct from the semantic aggregate-byte review sum, which includes only actually verified retained child bytes. The archive-byte sum counts each archive occurrence once when submitted to decoding. The same original per-archive structural and byte checks remain; a bound can stop processing earlier, never authorize weaker checking. These ceilings reuse the current default decoder's 27 entries, 64 MiB file bound, 64 MiB + 1 MiB response + 2 MiB manifest total, twice-total archive bound, ratio/name/path/work bounds; the intake profile assigns those generic ceilings without granting any response.json/manifest.json role or larger filename-specific allowance. Transport recursiveExpansion=false and maxNestingDepth=0 remain response-transport rules, not intake accounting rules. A lower already-applicable storage/worker bound still stops work and remains explicitly blocked; it must not silently change this profile or yield favorable completeness. The exact profile-hash preimage is C({"version":"closed-loop-raw-units-zip-limits/1","scope":"INPUT_VERSION_PASS","maxEntries":27,"maxEntryBytes":67108864,"maxExpandedBytes":70254592,"maxArchiveBytes":140509184,"maxCompressionRatio":1100,"maxFilenameBytes":65535,"maxPathDepth":128,"maxNestingDepth":27,"workerTimeoutMs":600000}); its SHA-256 is the profile hash. The retained unitization derivation binds the owning input version, mapping ID, this exact profile ID/hash, actual counters and completion/blocker status; changed profile or source invalidates reuse under the existing derivation rules. The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

For a mechanically supported structured-media subdivision, emit one structural unit per exposed page, section, archive member, embedded document/object, comment, annotation, tracked change or metadata object, using its exact parent and source locator; traverse children in source order, breaking any absent source-order tie by unsigned Unicode-scalar locator order. Recurse into textual leaves using the physical-content rule and into child media using this rule. A structural node is counted once per occurrence/location/kind; a node's structural unit and its descendant content units are distinct. Preserve inaccessible exposed nodes as INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED; do not fabricate children. Detailed coverage requires a closed format mapping that is part of this named versioned normative algorithm or an explicitly identified versioned normative format mapping authorized under §34.3. Merely publishing an implementation descriptor does not authorize such semantics. The mapping must fix node kinds, source locators, ordering, exact canonical source values and child extraction. This insertion adds no format-specific adapter or mapping. A claim of supported detailed coverage without that normative mapping is blocked; genuinely unsupported formats retain the fallback below. A mechanically available subdivision cannot be suppressed or relabeled unsupported to avoid that blocker.

Subdivision is additive: an exact UTF-8 whole-file projection emits its physical spans even when a supported structured mapping also emits structural nodes and textual leaves. Whole-file spans, structural nodes and structural textual-leaf spans have distinct kinds and locators and are all counted; overlap in underlying bytes does not deduplicate these different accounting obligations. Each archive-member or embedded-file occurrence emits both its parent structural occurrence unit and its own child inventory unit, followed by its own supported content/subdivisions. A textual leaf is not a child file and gets no inventory unit. Repeated references to the same emitted unit still deduplicate under the rule below.

Source hashes and binding are closed as follows. C(x) means the exact UTF-8 bytes of §34.1 canonical JSON; H(b) means lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal of exact bytes b. Source-value hash preimages by kind are:

If bytes are unavailable, both values are null; asserted length/digest remains source context, never substituted for observed bytes. The unit remains inaccessible/blocked, with its retained occurrence/locator binding.

- PHYSICAL_SPAN: the exact original byte span including its terminator, without canonical JSON wrapping. Its locator binds zero-based byte start and exclusive end plus the one-based page/line coordinates.

- STRUCTURAL_NODE: C({"nodeKind":k,"status":q,"value":v}), where k and v are the exact kind and canonical source value fixed by the authorized format mapping, and q is ACCESSIBLE or INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED. Inaccessible nodes have v=null; exact exposed parent/locator and k remain bound. No invented serialization of an adapter object is permitted.

- STRUCTURAL_TEXT_SPAN: exact UTF-8 bytes of the mapped exact textual leaf's physical span, including its terminator. The authorized mapping identifies the leaf and its exact extraction; no silent whitespace normalization is allowed.

Each unit's binding hash preimage is C({"algorithm":"closed-loop-raw-units/1","inputVersion":V,"occurrence":O,"kind":K,"locator":L,"sourceValueSha256":S}). V is the exact owning input-version identity string; O is the ordered zero-based safe-integer path of supplied root and, where applicable, child-member occurrence indices; K is exactly one of the seven uppercase kinds above; S is the corresponding source-value hash. L is an ordered locator array: human units use [originating JSON pointer, one-based physical line] or [originating JSON pointer] for whole strings/scalars; inventories use []; whole-file spans use [startByte,endByte,page,line]; structural nodes use [normative format mapping ID, exact mapping locator]; structural textual spans append [startByte,endByte,page,line] to their structural-leaf locator. Byte offsets for a structural textual leaf refer to its exact UTF-8 extraction. The source-value hash alone does not identify the occurrence: binding hash plus retained input/source supplies the exact type, location and occurrence. These accounting hashes/locators are not §34.2 canonical record IDs. Distinct roots are numbered in retained source occurrence order, including separately supplied identical roots; a canonical mirror does not receive a second root number.

An image/media occurrence without a supported finer subdivision uses its inventory unit as its whole-media unit. A format with no supported mechanically available subdivision likewise uses its inventory unit as the whole-file fallback, with an explicit unsupported/unavailable-subdivision basis and the original bytes retained. These fallbacks neither prove inspection nor remove existing material uncertainty/blockers. Comments, annotations, tracked changes, metadata and embedded content are not discarded as nonsemantic.

Deduplicate only repeated accounting references to the same occurrence, kind, location and exact source-value hash. Never merge distinct supplied occurrences, even with identical hashes. Order and retained source identity determine stable accounting references; canonical record IDs still use §34.2. Count the entire resulting unit universe, including inventory, structural and inaccessible units, when applying the unchanged §6.5A limits. Canonical comparison uses Unicode 15.1.0 NFC, case-sensitive identity, and separately checked Unicode 15.1.0 default-case-fold and registered platform-risk collision keys. Absolute paths, drive prefixes, NUL, control characters, empty segments, `.` and `..`, duplicate canonical paths, case-fold collisions, extraction-target collisions, and supported confusable collisions are rejected. An unauthorized rename never matches solely because bytes are equal.

File extension and browser MIME type are claims. Format-dependent work records the authorized parser or adapter and detected interpretation. A materially ambiguous polyglot is BLOCKED unless one interpretation is explicitly authorized and every alternate interpretation is harmless under the operation.

Archive intake and export fail closed on traversal, absolute paths, duplicate or colliding paths, symlinks, hard links, device entries, unsupported special files, unsupported or encrypted members outside a registered encrypted contract, unsupported compression, excessive nesting, entry count, per-entry size, total compressed or expanded size, compression ratio, path depth, filename length, Unicode ambiguity, manifest mismatch, unmanifested extra members, missing members, or modified bytes. Expansion occurs only in an isolated bounded parser path and never makes content executable or prompt-visible by itself.

Every normalizer and application derivation has an immutable registry ID, version, implementation-owner file, canonical input contract, output contract, hash or build identity, and invalidation consequences. Every derived value records the exact derivation ID and source-record hashes. A changed normalizer or derivation invalidates affected current values and results unless an explicit compatibility migration proves byte- and semantic-equivalent output.

Every release-bearing derivation and normalizer is completely defined by this specification or by an explicitly named versioned normative algorithm. The semantics defined in Sections 14.6, 15, 16.1, 26, 29, 30, 31, 34.1, 34.2, and 36 control their registry entries, and an entry cannot deviate from them. A release-bearing derivation or normalizer whose semantics are not so defined is UNDEFINED_DERIVATION and blocks acceptance.

The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

For a mechanically supported structured-media subdivision, emit one structural unit per exposed page, section, archive member, embedded document/object, comment, annotation, tracked change or metadata object, using its exact parent and source locator; traverse children in source order, breaking any absent source-order tie by unsigned Unicode-scalar locator order. Recurse into textual leaves using the physical-content rule and into child media using this rule. A structural node is counted once per occurrence/location/kind; a node's structural unit and its descendant content units are distinct. Preserve inaccessible exposed nodes as INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED; do not fabricate children. Detailed coverage requires a closed format mapping that is part of this named versioned normative algorithm or an explicitly identified versioned normative format mapping authorized under §34.3. Merely publishing an implementation descriptor does not authorize such semantics. The mapping must fix node kinds, source locators, ordering, exact canonical source values and child extraction. This insertion adds no format-specific adapter or mapping. A claim of supported detailed coverage without that normative mapping is blocked; genuinely unsupported formats retain the fallback below. A mechanically available subdivision cannot be suppressed or relabeled unsupported to avoid that blocker.

Subdivision is additive: an exact UTF-8 whole-file projection emits its physical spans even when a supported structured mapping also emits structural nodes and textual leaves. Whole-file spans, structural nodes and structural textual-leaf spans have distinct kinds and locators and are all counted; overlap in underlying bytes does not deduplicate these different accounting obligations. Each archive-member or embedded-file occurrence emits both its parent structural occurrence unit and its own child inventory unit, followed by its own supported content/subdivisions. A textual leaf is not a child file and gets no inventory unit. Repeated references to the same emitted unit still deduplicate under the rule below.

Source hashes and binding are closed as follows. C(x) means the exact UTF-8 bytes of §34.1 canonical JSON; H(b) means lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal of exact bytes b. Source-value hash preimages by kind are:

V is the exact owning input-version identity string; O is the ordered zero-based safe-integer path of supplied root and, where applicable, child-member occurrence indices; K is exactly one of the seven uppercase kinds above; S is the corresponding source-value hash. The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. Every artifact preserves rawFilename and has a safe displayFilename and canonicalPath under closed-loop-filename/1. Canonical comparison uses Unicode 15.1.0 NFC, case-sensitive identity, and separately checked Unicode 15.1.0 default-case-fold and registered platform-risk collision keys. An unauthorized rename never matches solely because bytes are equal.

File extension and browser MIME type are claims. Format-dependent work records the authorized parser or adapter and detected interpretation. A materially ambiguous polyglot is BLOCKED unless one interpretation is explicitly authorized and every alternate interpretation is harmless under the operation.

Archive intake and export fail closed on traversal, absolute paths, duplicate or colliding paths, symlinks, hard links, device entries, unsupported special files, unsupported or encrypted members outside a registered encrypted contract, unsupported compression, excessive nesting, entry count, per-entry size, total compressed or expanded size, compression ratio, path depth, filename length, Unicode ambiguity, manifest mismatch, unmanifested extra members, missing members, or modified bytes. Expansion occurs only in an isolated bounded parser path and never makes content executable or prompt-visible by itself.

Every normalizer and application derivation has an immutable registry ID, version, implementation-owner file, canonical input contract, output contract, hash or build identity, and invalidation consequences. Every derived value records the exact derivation ID and source-record hashes. A changed normalizer or derivation invalidates affected current values and results unless an explicit compatibility migration proves byte- and semantic-equivalent output.
