The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

For a mechanically supported structured-media subdivision, emit one structural unit per exposed page, section, archive member, embedded document/object, comment, annotation, tracked change or metadata object, using its exact parent and source locator; traverse children in source order, breaking any absent source-order tie by unsigned Unicode-scalar locator order. Recurse into textual leaves using the physical-content rule and into child media using this rule. A structural node is counted once per occurrence/location/kind; a node's structural unit and its descendant content units are distinct. Preserve inaccessible exposed nodes as INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED; do not fabricate children. Detailed coverage requires a closed format mapping that is part of this named versioned normative algorithm or an explicitly identified versioned normative format mapping authorized under §34.3. Merely publishing an implementation descriptor does not authorize such semantics. The mapping must fix node kinds, source locators, ordering, exact canonical source values and child extraction. This insertion adds no format-specific adapter or mapping. A claim of supported detailed coverage without that normative mapping is blocked; genuinely unsupported formats retain the fallback below. A mechanically available subdivision cannot be suppressed or relabeled unsupported to avoid that blocker.

Subdivision is additive: an exact UTF-8 whole-file projection emits its physical spans even when a supported structured mapping also emits structural nodes and textual leaves. Whole-file spans, structural nodes and structural textual-leaf spans have distinct kinds and locators and are all counted; overlap in underlying bytes does not deduplicate these different accounting obligations. Each archive-member or embedded-file occurrence emits both its parent structural occurrence unit and its own child inventory unit, followed by its own supported content/subdivisions. A textual leaf is not a child file and gets no inventory unit. Repeated references to the same emitted unit still deduplicate under the rule below.

Source hashes and binding are closed as follows. C(x) means the exact UTF-8 bytes of §34.1 canonical JSON; H(b) means lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal of exact bytes b. Source-value hash preimages by kind are:

If bytes are unavailable, both values are null; asserted length/digest remains source context, never substituted for observed bytes. The unit remains inaccessible/blocked, with its retained occurrence/locator binding.

- PHYSICAL_SPAN: the exact original byte span including its terminator, without canonical JSON wrapping. Its locator binds zero-based byte start and exclusive end plus the one-based page/line coordinates.

- STRUCTURAL_NODE: C({"nodeKind":k,"status":q,"value":v}), where k and v are the exact kind and canonical source value fixed by the authorized format mapping, and q is ACCESSIBLE or INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED. Inaccessible nodes have v=null; exact exposed parent/locator and k remain bound. No invented serialization of an adapter object is permitted.

Each unit's binding hash preimage is C({"algorithm":"closed-loop-raw-units/1","inputVersion":V,"occurrence":O,"kind":K,"locator":L,"sourceValueSha256":S}). V is the exact owning input-version identity string; O is the ordered zero-based safe-integer path of supplied root and, where applicable, child-member occurrence indices; K is exactly one of the seven uppercase kinds above; S is the corresponding source-value hash. L is an ordered locator array: human units use [originating JSON pointer, one-based physical line] or [originating JSON pointer] for whole strings/scalars; inventories use []; whole-file spans use [startByte,endByte,page,line]; structural nodes use [normative format mapping ID, exact mapping locator]; structural textual spans append [startByte,endByte,page,line] to their structural-leaf locator. Byte offsets for a structural textual leaf refer to its exact UTF-8 extraction. The source-value hash alone does not identify the occurrence: binding hash plus retained input/source supplies the exact type, location and occurrence. These accounting hashes/locators are not §34.2 canonical record IDs. Distinct roots are numbered in retained source occurrence order, including separately supplied identical roots; a canonical mirror does not receive a second root number.

An image/media occurrence without a supported finer subdivision uses its inventory unit as its whole-media unit. A format with no supported mechanically available subdivision likewise uses its inventory unit as the whole-file fallback, with an explicit unsupported/unavailable-subdivision basis and the original bytes retained. These fallbacks neither prove inspection nor remove existing material uncertainty/blockers. Comments, annotations, tracked changes, metadata and embedded content are not discarded as nonsemantic.

Deduplicate only repeated accounting references to the same occurrence, kind, location and exact source-value hash. Never merge distinct supplied occurrences, even with identical hashes. Order and retained source identity determine stable accounting references; canonical record IDs still use §34.2. Count the entire resulting unit universe, including inventory, structural and inaccessible units, when applying the unchanged §6.5A limits. The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

For a mechanically supported structured-media subdivision, emit one structural unit per exposed page, section, archive member, embedded document/object, comment, annotation, tracked change or metadata object, using its exact parent and source locator; traverse children in source order, breaking any absent source-order tie by unsigned Unicode-scalar locator order. A structural node is counted once per occurrence/location/kind; a node's structural unit and its descendant content units are distinct. Merely publishing an implementation descriptor does not authorize such semantics. The mapping must fix node kinds, source locators, ordering, exact canonical source values and child extraction. Subdivision is additive: an exact UTF-8 whole-file projection emits its physical spans even when a supported structured mapping also emits structural nodes and textual leaves. Whole-file spans, structural nodes and structural textual-leaf spans have distinct kinds and locators and are all counted; overlap in underlying bytes does not deduplicate these different accounting obligations. Each archive-member or embedded-file occurrence emits both its parent structural occurrence unit and its own child inventory unit, followed by its own supported content/subdivisions. A textual leaf is not a child file and gets no inventory unit. Repeated references to the same emitted unit still deduplicate under the rule below.

Source hashes and binding are closed as follows. C(x) means the exact UTF-8 bytes of §34.1 canonical JSON; H(b) means lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal of exact bytes b. Source-value hash preimages by kind are:

- PHYSICAL_SPAN: the exact original byte span including its terminator, without canonical JSON wrapping. Its locator binds zero-based byte start and exclusive end plus the one-based page/line coordinates.

- STRUCTURAL_NODE: C({"nodeKind":k,"status":q,"value":v}), where k and v are the exact kind and canonical source value fixed by the authorized format mapping, and q is ACCESSIBLE or INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED. Inaccessible nodes have v=null; exact exposed parent/locator and k remain bound. No invented serialization of an adapter object is permitted.

Each unit's binding hash preimage is C({"algorithm":"closed-loop-raw-units/1","inputVersion":V,"occurrence":O,"kind":K,"locator":L,"sourceValueSha256":S}). V is the exact owning input-version identity string; O is the ordered zero-based safe-integer path of supplied root and, where applicable, child-member occurrence indices; K is exactly one of the seven uppercase kinds above; S is the corresponding source-value hash. Distinct roots are numbered in retained source occurrence order, including separately supplied identical roots; a canonical mirror does not receive a second root number.

An image/media occurrence without a supported finer subdivision uses its inventory unit as its whole-media unit. A format with no supported mechanically available subdivision likewise uses its inventory unit as the whole-file fallback, with an explicit unsupported/unavailable-subdivision basis and the original bytes retained. These fallbacks neither prove inspection nor remove existing material uncertainty/blockers. Comments, annotations, tracked changes, metadata and embedded content are not discarded as nonsemantic.

Its bounds are: 27 cumulative central-directory entries across the entire selected input-version archive-mapping pass, including every supplied root and recursively decoded child; 67108864 bytes per expanded member; 70254592 cumulative reserved-or-produced expanded bytes; 140509184 cumulative archive bytes submitted to decoding (count a nested archive again when it is submitted); compression ratio at most 1100 per member; filename byte length at most 65535; canonical path depth at most 128; maximum archive nesting level 27 with the supplied archive at level 1; and one cumulative elapsed-worker deadline of 600000 ms for that entire input-version archive-mapping pass. The entry budget is charged on exposure before expansion, including unsupported/blocked entries; the maximum depth cannot bypass that budget. Expansion and byte accounting are checked before allocation and incrementally, against both declared and actual lengths; declared metadata never substitutes for verified bytes. The expansion safety counter reserves each declared output length before allocation; actual production within that reservation does not charge the same byte twice, while any additional produced byte must first fit and consume remaining budget. Every produced/reserved byte remains charged even if later CRC, validation or decoding fails; no refund, reset or retry can escape the pass-wide ceiling. It includes every child occurrence at every depth, including a nested archive's bytes as its parent's output and its own children separately. This work-safety counter is distinct from the semantic aggregate-byte review sum, which includes only actually verified retained child bytes. The archive-byte sum counts each archive occurrence once when submitted to decoding. The same original per-archive structural and byte checks remain; a bound can stop processing earlier, never authorize weaker checking. These ceilings reuse the current default decoder's 27 entries, 64 MiB file bound, 64 MiB + 1 MiB response + 2 MiB manifest total, twice-total archive bound, ratio/name/path/work bounds; the intake profile assigns those generic ceilings without granting any response.json/manifest.json role or larger filename-specific allowance. Transport recursiveExpansion=false and maxNestingDepth=0 remain response-transport rules, not intake accounting rules. A lower already-applicable storage/worker bound still stops work and remains explicitly blocked; it must not silently change this profile or yield favorable completeness. The exact profile-hash preimage is C({"version":"closed-loop-raw-units-zip-limits/1","scope":"INPUT_VERSION_PASS","maxEntries":27,"maxEntryBytes":67108864,"maxExpandedBytes":70254592,"maxArchiveBytes":140509184,"maxCompressionRatio":1100,"maxFilenameBytes":65535,"maxPathDepth":128,"maxNestingDepth":27,"workerTimeoutMs":600000}); its SHA-256 is the profile hash. The retained unitization derivation binds the owning input version, mapping ID, this exact profile ID/hash, actual counters and completion/blocker status; changed profile or source invalidates reuse under the existing derivation rules. Repeated equal roots and members are charged separately. Any future profile change follows existing versioning and acceptance requirements.
Recognition and bounded decoding

Every artifact preserves rawFilename and has a safe displayFilename and canonicalPath under closed-loop-filename/1. Canonical comparison uses Unicode 15.1.0 NFC, case-sensitive identity, and separately checked Unicode 15.1.0 default-case-fold and registered platform-risk collision keys. Absolute paths, drive prefixes, NUL, control characters, empty segments, `.` and `..`, duplicate canonical paths, case-fold collisions, extraction-target collisions, and supported confusable collisions are rejected. An unauthorized rename never matches solely because bytes are equal.

File extension and browser MIME type are claims. Format-dependent work records the authorized parser or adapter and detected interpretation. A materially ambiguous polyglot is BLOCKED unless one interpretation is explicitly authorized and every alternate interpretation is harmless under the operation.

Archive intake and export fail closed on traversal, absolute paths, duplicate or colliding paths, symlinks, hard links, device entries, unsupported special files, unsupported or encrypted members outside a registered encrypted contract, unsupported compression, excessive nesting, entry count, per-entry size, total compressed or expanded size, compression ratio, path depth, filename length, Unicode ambiguity, manifest mismatch, unmanifested extra members, missing members, or modified bytes. Expansion occurs only in an isolated bounded parser path and never makes content executable or prompt-visible by itself.

Every normalizer and application derivation has an immutable registry ID, version, implementation-owner file, canonical input contract, output contract, hash or build identity, and invalidation consequences. Every derived value records the exact derivation ID and source-record hashes. A changed normalizer or derivation invalidates affected current values and results unless an explicit compatibility migration proves byte- and semantic-equivalent output.

Every release-bearing derivation and normalizer is completely defined by this specification or by an explicitly named versioned normative algorithm. The semantics defined in Sections 14.6, 15, 16.1, 26, 29, 30, 31, 34.1, 34.2, and 36 control their registry entries, and an entry cannot deviate from them. A release-bearing derivation or normalizer whose semantics are not so defined is UNDEFINED_DERIVATION and blocks acceptance.
C. Insert after §6.5A: normative algorithm closed-loop-raw-units/1

The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

For a mechanically supported structured-media subdivision, emit one structural unit per exposed page, section, archive member, embedded document/object, comment, annotation, tracked change or metadata object, using its exact parent and source locator; traverse children in source order, breaking any absent source-order tie by unsigned Unicode-scalar locator order. Recurse into textual leaves using the physical-content rule and into child media using this rule. A structural node is counted once per occurrence/location/kind; a node's structural unit and its descendant content units are distinct. Preserve inaccessible exposed nodes as INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED; do not fabricate children. Detailed coverage requires a closed format mapping that is part of this named versioned normative algorithm or an explicitly identified versioned normative format mapping authorized under §34.3. Merely publishing an implementation descriptor does not authorize such semantics. The mapping must fix node kinds, source locators, ordering, exact canonical source values and child extraction. This insertion adds no format-specific adapter or mapping. A claim of supported detailed coverage without that normative mapping is blocked; genuinely unsupported formats retain the fallback below. A mechanically available subdivision cannot be suppressed or relabeled unsupported to avoid that blocker.

Subdivision is additive: an exact UTF-8 whole-file projection emits its physical spans even when a supported structured mapping also emits structural nodes and textual leaves. Whole-file spans, structural nodes and structural textual-leaf spans have distinct kinds and locators and are all counted; overlap in underlying bytes does not deduplicate these different accounting obligations. Each archive-member or embedded-file occurrence emits both its parent structural occurrence unit and its own child inventory unit, followed by its own supported content/subdivisions. A textual leaf is not a child file and gets no inventory unit. Repeated references to the same emitted unit still deduplicate under the rule below.

Source hashes and binding are closed as follows. C(x) means the exact UTF-8 bytes of §34.1 canonical JSON; H(b) means lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal of exact bytes b. Source-value hash preimages by kind are:

- ARTIFACT_INVENTORY: C({"byteLength":n,"contentSha256":h}), where n is exact byte length and h=H(exact artifact bytes). If bytes are unavailable, both values are null; asserted length/digest remains source context, never substituted for observed bytes. The unit remains inaccessible/blocked, with its retained occurrence/locator binding.

- PHYSICAL_SPAN: the exact original byte span including its terminator, without canonical JSON wrapping. Its locator binds zero-based byte start and exclusive end plus the one-based page/line coordinates.

- STRUCTURAL_NODE: C({"nodeKind":k,"status":q,"value":v}), where k and v are the exact kind and canonical source value fixed by the authorized format mapping, and q is ACCESSIBLE or INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED. Inaccessible nodes have v=null; exact exposed parent/locator and k remain bound. No invented serialization of an adapter object is permitted.

- STRUCTURAL_TEXT_SPAN: exact UTF-8 bytes of the mapped exact textual leaf's physical span, including its terminator. The authorized mapping identifies the leaf and its exact extraction; no silent whitespace normalization is allowed.

Each unit's binding hash preimage is C({"algorithm":"closed-loop-raw-units/1","inputVersion":V,"occurrence":O,"kind":K,"locator":L,"sourceValueSha256":S}). V is the exact owning input-version identity string; O is the ordered zero-based safe-integer path of supplied root and, where applicable, child-member occurrence indices; K is exactly one of the seven uppercase kinds above; S is the corresponding source-value hash. L is an ordered locator array: human units use [originating JSON pointer, one-based physical line] or [originating JSON pointer] for whole strings/scalars; inventories use []; whole-file spans use [startByte,endByte,page,line]; structural nodes use [normative format mapping ID, exact mapping locator]; structural textual spans append [startByte,endByte,page,line] to their structural-leaf locator. Byte offsets for a structural textual leaf refer to its exact UTF-8 extraction. The source-value hash alone does not identify the occurrence: binding hash plus retained input/source supplies the exact type, location and occurrence. These accounting hashes/locators are not §34.2 canonical record IDs. Distinct roots are numbered in retained source occurrence order, including separately supplied identical roots; a canonical mirror does not receive a second root number.

An image/media occurrence without a supported finer subdivision uses its inventory unit as its whole-media unit. A format with no supported mechanically available subdivision likewise uses its inventory unit as the whole-file fallback, with an explicit unsupported/unavailable-subdivision basis and the original bytes retained. These fallbacks neither prove inspection nor remove existing material uncertainty/blockers. Comments, annotations, tracked changes, metadata and embedded content are not discarded as nonsemantic.

Deduplicate only repeated accounting references to the same occurrence, kind, location and exact source-value hash. Never merge distinct supplied occurrences, even with identical hashes. Order and retained source identity determine stable accounting references; canonical record IDs still use §34.2. Count the entire resulting unit universe, including inventory, structural and inaccessible units, when applying the unchanged §6.5A limits. The raw-unit challenge condition is strictly greater than 500, not greater than or equal to 500; every other size-independent trigger remains effective.

The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Source hashes and binding are closed as follows. C(x) means the exact UTF-8 bytes of §34.1 canonical JSON; H(b) means lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal of exact bytes b. Source-value hash preimages by kind are:

The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

For a mechanically supported structured-media subdivision, emit one structural unit per exposed page, section, archive member, embedded document/object, comment, annotation, tracked change or metadata object, using its exact parent and source locator; traverse children in source order, breaking any absent source-order tie by unsigned Unicode-scalar locator order. Recurse into textual leaves using the physical-content rule and into child media using this rule. A structural node is counted once per occurrence/location/kind; a node's structural unit and its descendant content units are distinct. Preserve inaccessible exposed nodes as INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED; do not fabricate children. Detailed coverage requires a closed format mapping that is part of this named versioned normative algorithm or an explicitly identified versioned normative format mapping authorized under §34.3. Merely publishing an implementation descriptor does not authorize such semantics. The mapping must fix node kinds, source locators, ordering, exact canonical source values and child extraction. This insertion adds no format-specific adapter or mapping. A claim of supported detailed coverage without that normative mapping is blocked; genuinely unsupported formats retain the fallback below. Subdivision is additive: an exact UTF-8 whole-file projection emits its physical spans even when a supported structured mapping also emits structural nodes and textual leaves. File extension and browser MIME type are claims. Format-dependent work records the authorized parser or adapter and detected interpretation. Archive intake and export fail closed on traversal, absolute paths, duplicate or colliding paths, symlinks, hard links, device entries, unsupported special files, unsupported or encrypted members outside a registered encrypted contract, unsupported compression, excessive nesting, entry count, per-entry size, total compressed or expanded size, compression ratio, path depth, filename length, Unicode ambiguity, manifest mismatch, unmanifested extra members, missing members, or modified bytes. Expansion occurs only in an isolated bounded parser path and never makes content executable or prompt-visible by itself.

The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

For a mechanically supported structured-media subdivision, emit one structural unit per exposed page, section, archive member, embedded document/object, comment, annotation, tracked change or metadata object, using its exact parent and source locator; traverse children in source order, breaking any absent source-order tie by unsigned Unicode-scalar locator order. Recurse into textual leaves using the physical-content rule and into child media using this rule. A structural node is counted once per occurrence/location/kind; a node's structural unit and its descendant content units are distinct. Preserve inaccessible exposed nodes as INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED; do not fabricate children. Detailed coverage requires a closed format mapping that is part of this named versioned normative algorithm or an explicitly identified versioned normative format mapping authorized under §34.3. Merely publishing an implementation descriptor does not authorize such semantics. The mapping must fix node kinds, source locators, ordering, exact canonical source values and child extraction. This insertion adds no format-specific adapter or mapping. A claim of supported detailed coverage without that normative mapping is blocked; genuinely unsupported formats retain the fallback below. A mechanically available subdivision cannot be suppressed or relabeled unsupported to avoid that blocker.

Subdivision is additive: an exact UTF-8 whole-file projection emits its physical spans even when a supported structured mapping also emits structural nodes and textual leaves. Whole-file spans, structural nodes and structural textual-leaf spans have distinct kinds and locators and are all counted; overlap in underlying bytes does not deduplicate these different accounting obligations. Each archive-member or embedded-file occurrence emits both its parent structural occurrence unit and its own child inventory unit, followed by its own supported content/subdivisions. A textual leaf is not a child file and gets no inventory unit. Repeated references to the same emitted unit still deduplicate under the rule below.

Source hashes and binding are closed as follows. C(x) means the exact UTF-8 bytes of §34.1 canonical JSON; H(b) means lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal of exact bytes b. Source-value hash preimages by kind are:

- ARTIFACT_INVENTORY: C({"byteLength":n,"contentSha256":h}), where n is exact byte length and h=H(exact artifact bytes). If bytes are unavailable, both values are null; asserted length/digest remains source context, never substituted for observed bytes. The unit remains inaccessible/blocked, with its retained occurrence/locator binding.

- PHYSICAL_SPAN: the exact original byte span including its terminator, without canonical JSON wrapping. Its locator binds zero-based byte start and exclusive end plus the one-based page/line coordinates.

- STRUCTURAL_NODE: C({"nodeKind":k,"status":q,"value":v}), where k and v are the exact kind and canonical source value fixed by the authorized format mapping, and q is ACCESSIBLE or INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED. Inaccessible nodes have v=null; exact exposed parent/locator and k remain bound. No invented serialization of an adapter object is permitted.

- STRUCTURAL_TEXT_SPAN: exact UTF-8 bytes of the mapped exact textual leaf's physical span, including its terminator. The authorized mapping identifies the leaf and its exact extraction; no silent whitespace normalization is allowed.

Each unit's binding hash preimage is C({"algorithm":"closed-loop-raw-units/1","inputVersion":V,"occurrence":O,"kind":K,"locator":L,"sourceValueSha256":S}). V is the exact owning input-version identity string; O is the ordered zero-based safe-integer path of supplied root and, where applicable, child-member occurrence indices; K is exactly one of the seven uppercase kinds above; S is the corresponding source-value hash. L is an ordered locator array: human units use [originating JSON pointer, one-based physical line] or [originating JSON pointer] for whole strings/scalars; inventories use []; whole-file spans use [startByte,endByte,page,line]; structural nodes use [normative format mapping ID, exact mapping locator]; structural textual spans append [startByte,endByte,page,line] to their structural-leaf locator. Byte offsets for a structural textual leaf refer to its exact UTF-8 extraction. The source-value hash alone does not identify the occurrence: binding hash plus retained input/source supplies the exact type, location and occurrence. These accounting hashes/locators are not §34.2 canonical record IDs. Distinct roots are numbered in retained source occurrence order, including separately supplied identical roots; a canonical mirror does not receive a second root number.

An image/media occurrence without a supported finer subdivision uses its inventory unit as its whole-media unit. A format with no supported mechanically available subdivision likewise uses its inventory unit as the whole-file fallback, with an explicit unsupported/unavailable-subdivision basis and the original bytes retained. These fallbacks neither prove inspection nor remove existing material uncertainty/blockers. Comments, annotations, tracked changes, metadata and embedded content are not discarded as nonsemantic.

Deduplicate only repeated accounting references to the same occurrence, kind, location and exact source-value hash. Never merge distinct supplied occurrences, even with identical hashes. Order and retained source identity determine stable accounting references; canonical record IDs still use §34.2. Count the entire resulting unit universe, including inventory, structural and inaccessible units, when applying the unchanged §6.5A limits. The raw-unit challenge condition is strictly greater than 500, not greater than or equal to 500; every other size-independent trigger remains effective.

Subdivision is additive: an exact UTF-8 whole-file projection emits its physical spans even when a supported structured mapping also emits structural nodes and textual leaves. Whole-file spans, structural nodes and structural textual-leaf spans have distinct kinds and locators and are all counted; overlap in underlying bytes does not deduplicate these different accounting obligations. Each archive-member or embedded-file occurrence emits both its parent structural occurrence unit and its own child inventory unit, followed by its own supported content/subdivisions. A textual leaf is not a child file and gets no inventory unit. Repeated references to the same emitted unit still deduplicate under the rule below.

Source hashes and binding are closed as follows. C(x) means the exact UTF-8 bytes of §34.1 canonical JSON; H(b) means lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal of exact bytes b. Source-value hash preimages by kind are:

- ARTIFACT_INVENTORY: C({"byteLength":n,"contentSha256":h}), where n is exact byte length and h=H(exact artifact bytes). If bytes are unavailable, both values are null; asserted length/digest remains source context, never substituted for observed bytes. The unit remains inaccessible/blocked, with its retained occurrence/locator binding.

- PHYSICAL_SPAN: the exact original byte span including its terminator, without canonical JSON wrapping. Its locator binds zero-based byte start and exclusive end plus the one-based page/line coordinates.

- STRUCTURAL_NODE: C({"nodeKind":k,"status":q,"value":v}), where k and v are the exact kind and canonical source value fixed by the authorized format mapping, and q is ACCESSIBLE or INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED. Inaccessible nodes have v=null; exact exposed parent/locator and k remain bound. No invented serialization of an adapter object is permitted.

- STRUCTURAL_TEXT_SPAN: exact UTF-8 bytes of the mapped exact textual leaf's physical span, including its terminator. The authorized mapping identifies the leaf and its exact extraction; no silent whitespace normalization is allowed.

Each unit's binding hash preimage is C({"algorithm":"closed-loop-raw-units/1","inputVersion":V,"occurrence":O,"kind":K,"locator":L,"sourceValueSha256":S}). V is the exact owning input-version identity string; O is the ordered zero-based safe-integer path of supplied root and, where applicable, child-member occurrence indices; K is exactly one of the seven uppercase kinds above; S is the corresponding source-value hash. L is an ordered locator array: human units use [originating JSON pointer, one-based physical line] or [originating JSON pointer] for whole strings/scalars; inventories use []; whole-file spans use [startByte,endByte,page,line]; structural nodes use [normative format mapping ID, exact mapping locator]; structural textual spans append [startByte,endByte,page,line] to their structural-leaf locator. Byte offsets for a structural textual leaf refer to its exact UTF-8 extraction. The source-value hash alone does not identify the occurrence: binding hash plus retained input/source supplies the exact type, location and occurrence. Distinct roots are numbered in retained source occurrence order, including separately supplied identical roots; a canonical mirror does not receive a second root number.

An image/media occurrence without a supported finer subdivision uses its inventory unit as its whole-media unit. Deduplicate only repeated accounting references to the same occurrence, kind, location and exact source-value hash. Never merge distinct supplied occurrences, even with identical hashes. The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

Recurse into textual leaves using the physical-content rule and into child media using this rule. A structural node is counted once per occurrence/location/kind; a node's structural unit and its descendant content units are distinct. Preserve inaccessible exposed nodes as INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED; do not fabricate children. For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

For a mechanically supported structured-media subdivision, emit one structural unit per exposed page, section, archive member, embedded document/object, comment, annotation, tracked change or metadata object, using its exact parent and source locator; traverse children in source order, breaking any absent source-order tie by unsigned Unicode-scalar locator order. Subdivision is additive: an exact UTF-8 whole-file projection emits its physical spans even when a supported structured mapping also emits structural nodes and textual leaves. Source hashes and binding are closed as follows. C(x) means the exact UTF-8 bytes of §34.1 canonical JSON; H(b) means lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal of exact bytes b. Source-value hash preimages by kind are:

If bytes are unavailable, both values are null; asserted length/digest remains source context, never substituted for observed bytes. The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

For a mechanically supported structured-media subdivision, emit one structural unit per exposed page, section, archive member, embedded document/object, comment, annotation, tracked change or metadata object, using its exact parent and source locator; traverse children in source order, breaking any absent source-order tie by unsigned Unicode-scalar locator order. Recurse into textual leaves using the physical-content rule and into child media using this rule. A structural node is counted once per occurrence/location/kind; a node's structural unit and its descendant content units are distinct. Preserve inaccessible exposed nodes as INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED; do not fabricate children. Detailed coverage requires a closed format mapping that is part of this named versioned normative algorithm or an explicitly identified versioned normative format mapping authorized under §34.3. Merely publishing an implementation descriptor does not authorize such semantics. The mapping must fix node kinds, source locators, ordering, exact canonical source values and child extraction. A mechanically available subdivision cannot be suppressed or relabeled unsupported to avoid that blocker.

Subdivision is additive: an exact UTF-8 whole-file projection emits its physical spans even when a supported structured mapping also emits structural nodes and textual leaves. Each archive-member or embedded-file occurrence emits both its parent structural occurrence unit and its own child inventory unit, followed by its own supported content/subdivisions. A textual leaf is not a child file and gets no inventory unit. Repeated references to the same emitted unit still deduplicate under the rule below.

Source hashes and binding are closed as follows. C(x) means the exact UTF-8 bytes of §34.1 canonical JSON; H(b) means lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal of exact bytes b. Source-value hash preimages by kind are:

- ARTIFACT_INVENTORY: C({"byteLength":n,"contentSha256":h}), where n is exact byte length and h=H(exact artifact bytes). If bytes are unavailable, both values are null; asserted length/digest remains source context, never substituted for observed bytes. The unit remains inaccessible/blocked, with its retained occurrence/locator binding.

- PHYSICAL_SPAN: the exact original byte span including its terminator, without canonical JSON wrapping. Its locator binds zero-based byte start and exclusive end plus the one-based page/line coordinates.

- STRUCTURAL_NODE: C({"nodeKind":k,"status":q,"value":v}), where k and v are the exact kind and canonical source value fixed by the authorized format mapping, and q is ACCESSIBLE or INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED. Inaccessible nodes have v=null; exact exposed parent/locator and k remain bound. No invented serialization of an adapter object is permitted.

V is the exact owning input-version identity string; O is the ordered zero-based safe-integer path of supplied root and, where applicable, child-member occurrence indices; K is exactly one of the seven uppercase kinds above; S is the corresponding source-value hash. An image/media occurrence without a supported finer subdivision uses its inventory unit as its whole-media unit. Every artifact preserves rawFilename and has a safe displayFilename and canonicalPath under closed-loop-filename/1. Canonical comparison uses Unicode 15.1.0 NFC, case-sensitive identity, and separately checked Unicode 15.1.0 default-case-fold and registered platform-risk collision keys. Absolute paths, drive prefixes, NUL, control characters, empty segments, `.` and `..`, duplicate canonical paths, case-fold collisions, extraction-target collisions, and supported confusable collisions are rejected. An unauthorized rename never matches solely because bytes are equal.

File extension and browser MIME type are claims. Format-dependent work records the authorized parser or adapter and detected interpretation. A materially ambiguous polyglot is BLOCKED unless one interpretation is explicitly authorized and every alternate interpretation is harmless under the operation.

Archive intake and export fail closed on traversal, absolute paths, duplicate or colliding paths, symlinks, hard links, device entries, unsupported special files, unsupported or encrypted members outside a registered encrypted contract, unsupported compression, excessive nesting, entry count, per-entry size, total compressed or expanded size, compression ratio, path depth, filename length, Unicode ambiguity, manifest mismatch, unmanifested extra members, missing members, or modified bytes. Expansion occurs only in an isolated bounded parser path and never makes content executable or prompt-visible by itself.

Every normalizer and application derivation has an immutable registry ID, version, implementation-owner file, canonical input contract, output contract, hash or build identity, and invalidation consequences. Every derived value records the exact derivation ID and source-record hashes. A changed normalizer or derivation invalidates affected current values and results unless an explicit compatibility migration proves byte- and semantic-equivalent output.

Every release-bearing derivation and normalizer is completely defined by this specification or by an explicitly named versioned normative algorithm. The semantics defined in Sections 14.6, 15, 16.1, 26, 29, 30, 31, 34.1, 34.2, and 36 control their registry entries, and an entry cannot deviate from them. A release-bearing derivation or normalizer whose semantics are not so defined is UNDEFINED_DERIVATION and blocks acceptance.
C. Insert after §6.5A: normative algorithm closed-loop-raw-units/1

The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

For a mechanically supported structured-media subdivision, emit one structural unit per exposed page, section, archive member, embedded document/object, comment, annotation, tracked change or metadata object, using its exact parent and source locator; traverse children in source order, breaking any absent source-order tie by unsigned Unicode-scalar locator order. Recurse into textual leaves using the physical-content rule and into child media using this rule. A structural node is counted once per occurrence/location/kind; a node's structural unit and its descendant content units are distinct. Preserve inaccessible exposed nodes as INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED; do not fabricate children. Detailed coverage requires a closed format mapping that is part of this named versioned normative algorithm or an explicitly identified versioned normative format mapping authorized under §34.3. Merely publishing an implementation descriptor does not authorize such semantics. The mapping must fix node kinds, source locators, ordering, exact canonical source values and child extraction. This insertion adds no format-specific adapter or mapping. A claim of supported detailed coverage without that normative mapping is blocked; genuinely unsupported formats retain the fallback below. A mechanically available subdivision cannot be suppressed or relabeled unsupported to avoid that blocker.

Subdivision is additive: an exact UTF-8 whole-file projection emits its physical spans even when a supported structured mapping also emits structural nodes and textual leaves. Whole-file spans, structural nodes and structural textual-leaf spans have distinct kinds and locators and are all counted; overlap in underlying bytes does not deduplicate these different accounting obligations. Each archive-member or embedded-file occurrence emits both its parent structural occurrence unit and its own child inventory unit, followed by its own supported content/subdivisions. A textual leaf is not a child file and gets no inventory unit. Repeated references to the same emitted unit still deduplicate under the rule below.

Source hashes and binding are closed as follows. C(x) means the exact UTF-8 bytes of §34.1 canonical JSON; H(b) means lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal of exact bytes b. Source-value hash preimages by kind are:

- ARTIFACT_INVENTORY: C({"byteLength":n,"contentSha256":h}), where n is exact byte length and h=H(exact artifact bytes). If bytes are unavailable, both values are null; asserted length/digest remains source context, never substituted for observed bytes. The unit remains inaccessible/blocked, with its retained occurrence/locator binding.

- PHYSICAL_SPAN: the exact original byte span including its terminator, without canonical JSON wrapping. Its locator binds zero-based byte start and exclusive end plus the one-based page/line coordinates.

- STRUCTURAL_NODE: C({"nodeKind":k,"status":q,"value":v}), where k and v are the exact kind and canonical source value fixed by the authorized format mapping, and q is ACCESSIBLE or INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED. Inaccessible nodes have v=null; exact exposed parent/locator and k remain bound. No invented serialization of an adapter object is permitted.

- STRUCTURAL_TEXT_SPAN: exact UTF-8 bytes of the mapped exact textual leaf's physical span, including its terminator. The authorized mapping identifies the leaf and its exact extraction; no silent whitespace normalization is allowed.

Each unit's binding hash preimage is C({"algorithm":"closed-loop-raw-units/1","inputVersion":V,"occurrence":O,"kind":K,"locator":L,"sourceValueSha256":S}). V is the exact owning input-version identity string; O is the ordered zero-based safe-integer path of supplied root and, where applicable, child-member occurrence indices; K is exactly one of the seven uppercase kinds above; S is the corresponding source-value hash. L is an ordered locator array: human units use [originating JSON pointer, one-based physical line] or [originating JSON pointer] for whole strings/scalars; inventories use []; whole-file spans use [startByte,endByte,page,line]; structural nodes use [normative format mapping ID, exact mapping locator]; structural textual spans append [startByte,endByte,page,line] to their structural-leaf locator. Byte offsets for a structural textual leaf refer to its exact UTF-8 extraction. The source-value hash alone does not identify the occurrence: binding hash plus retained input/source supplies the exact type, location and occurrence. These accounting hashes/locators are not §34.2 canonical record IDs. Distinct roots are numbered in retained source occurrence order, including separately supplied identical roots; a canonical mirror does not receive a second root number.

An image/media occurrence without a supported finer subdivision uses its inventory unit as its whole-media unit. A format with no supported mechanically available subdivision likewise uses its inventory unit as the whole-file fallback, with an explicit unsupported/unavailable-subdivision basis and the original bytes retained. These fallbacks neither prove inspection nor remove existing material uncertainty/blockers. Comments, annotations, tracked changes, metadata and embedded content are not discarded as nonsemantic.

Deduplicate only repeated accounting references to the same occurrence, kind, location and exact source-value hash. Never merge distinct supplied occurrences, even with identical hashes. Order and retained source identity determine stable accounting references; canonical record IDs still use §34.2. Count the entire resulting unit universe, including inventory, structural and inaccessible units, when applying the unchanged §6.5A limits. The raw-unit challenge condition is strictly greater than 500, not greater than or equal to 500; every other size-independent trigger remains effective.

The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. If bytes are unavailable, both values are null; asserted length/digest remains source context, never substituted for observed bytes. The unit remains inaccessible/blocked, with its retained occurrence/locator binding.

- PHYSICAL_SPAN: the exact original byte span including its terminator, without canonical JSON wrapping. Its locator binds zero-based byte start and exclusive end plus the one-based page/line coordinates.

- STRUCTURAL_NODE: C({"nodeKind":k,"status":q,"value":v}), where k and v are the exact kind and canonical source value fixed by the authorized format mapping, and q is ACCESSIBLE or INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED. Inaccessible nodes have v=null; exact exposed parent/locator and k remain bound. No invented serialization of an adapter object is permitted.

- STRUCTURAL_TEXT_SPAN: exact UTF-8 bytes of the mapped exact textual leaf's physical span, including its terminator. The authorized mapping identifies the leaf and its exact extraction; no silent whitespace normalization is allowed.

Each unit's binding hash preimage is C({"algorithm":"closed-loop-raw-units/1","inputVersion":V,"occurrence":O,"kind":K,"locator":L,"sourceValueSha256":S}). V is the exact owning input-version identity string; O is the ordered zero-based safe-integer path of supplied root and, where applicable, child-member occurrence indices; K is exactly one of the seven uppercase kinds above; S is the corresponding source-value hash. L is an ordered locator array: human units use [originating JSON pointer, one-based physical line] or [originating JSON pointer] for whole strings/scalars; inventories use []; whole-file spans use [startByte,endByte,page,line]; structural nodes use [normative format mapping ID, exact mapping locator]; structural textual spans append [startByte,endByte,page,line] to their structural-leaf locator. Byte offsets for a structural textual leaf refer to its exact UTF-8 extraction. The source-value hash alone does not identify the occurrence: binding hash plus retained input/source supplies the exact type, location and occurrence. These accounting hashes/locators are not §34.2 canonical record IDs. Distinct roots are numbered in retained source occurrence order, including separately supplied identical roots; a canonical mirror does not receive a second root number.

An image/media occurrence without a supported finer subdivision uses its inventory unit as its whole-media unit. A format with no supported mechanically available subdivision likewise uses its inventory unit as the whole-file fallback, with an explicit unsupported/unavailable-subdivision basis and the original bytes retained. These fallbacks neither prove inspection nor remove existing material uncertainty/blockers. Comments, annotations, tracked changes, metadata and embedded content are not discarded as nonsemantic.

Deduplicate only repeated accounting references to the same occurrence, kind, location and exact source-value hash. Never merge distinct supplied occurrences, even with identical hashes. Order and retained source identity determine stable accounting references; canonical record IDs still use §34.2. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

contextSourceLocations.controllingText: C1. Named structured mapping: closed-loop-raw-units-zip/1

This mapping adopts accounting order, unit granularity, raw-name/metadata/comment identity, additive counts, recursive traversal and its explicit bounded intake profile only. It does not adopt arbitrary parser output as normative truth, authorize an unbounded parser or relaxed safety policy, establish semantic inspection, waive current evidence requirements, or accept historical coverage proof. Implementation must expose the required exact locators/bytes from the existing decoder without changing its retained safety predicates; actual boundary and fault tests remain due.
Failure and unknown content

Every artifact preserves rawFilename and has a safe displayFilename and canonicalPath under closed-loop-filename/1. Canonical comparison uses Unicode 15.1.0 NFC, case-sensitive identity, and separately checked Unicode 15.1.0 default-case-fold and registered platform-risk collision keys. Absolute paths, drive prefixes, NUL, control characters, empty segments, `.` and `..`, duplicate canonical paths, case-fold collisions, extraction-target collisions, and supported confusable collisions are rejected. An unauthorized rename never matches solely because bytes are equal.

File extension and browser MIME type are claims. Format-dependent work records the authorized parser or adapter and detected interpretation. A materially ambiguous polyglot is BLOCKED unless one interpretation is explicitly authorized and every alternate interpretation is harmless under the operation.

Archive intake and export fail closed on traversal, absolute paths, duplicate or colliding paths, symlinks, hard links, device entries, unsupported special files, unsupported or encrypted members outside a registered encrypted contract, unsupported compression, excessive nesting, entry count, per-entry size, total compressed or expanded size, compression ratio, path depth, filename length, Unicode ambiguity, manifest mismatch, unmanifested extra members, missing members, or modified bytes. Expansion occurs only in an isolated bounded parser path and never makes content executable or prompt-visible by itself.

Every normalizer and application derivation has an immutable registry ID, version, implementation-owner file, canonical input contract, output contract, hash or build identity, and invalidation consequences. Every derived value records the exact derivation ID and source-record hashes. A changed normalizer or derivation invalidates affected current values and results unless an explicit compatibility migration proves byte- and semantic-equivalent output.

Every release-bearing derivation and normalizer is completely defined by this specification or by an explicitly named versioned normative algorithm. The semantics defined in Sections 14.6, 15, 16.1, 26, 29, 30, 31, 34.1, 34.2, and 36 control their registry entries, and an entry cannot deviate from them. A release-bearing derivation or normalizer whose semantics are not so defined is UNDEFINED_DERIVATION and blocks acceptance.
C. Insert after §6.5A: normative algorithm closed-loop-raw-units/1

The unit universe is structural accounting. Retain the exact originating input and artifact bytes; no normalized projection replaces them or asserts inspection. Each unit binds the input version, supplied occurrence, exact structural location and source-value hash. Enumerate roots in their retained source occurrence order; within a structured value visit arrays in index order and object keys in unsigned Unicode-scalar order. A canonical mirror of the same originating field is visited only once, using the originating field; separately supplied equal values are separate occurrences.

For every supplied artifact occurrence, emit one inventory unit. Where exact bytes are valid UTF-8 and the text projection re-encodes to those exact bytes, also emit physical content units: scan left to right, treating CRLF as one terminator and otherwise CR, LF or form feed as a terminator; each unit contains the span through its terminator. Retain every nonempty span, including blank lines; emit a final unterminated span if present, but no zero-length trailing span. Coordinates start at page 1/line 1; form feed increments page and resets line to 1, other terminators increment line. BOM bytes, if present, remain part of the exact projection, not silently removed. This rule is accounting, not a claim that every UTF-8 artifact's media semantics have been parsed.

For a mechanically supported structured-media subdivision, emit one structural unit per exposed page, section, archive member, embedded document/object, comment, annotation, tracked change or metadata object, using its exact parent and source locator; traverse children in source order, breaking any absent source-order tie by unsigned Unicode-scalar locator order. Recurse into textual leaves using the physical-content rule and into child media using this rule. A structural node is counted once per occurrence/location/kind; a node's structural unit and its descendant content units are distinct. Preserve inaccessible exposed nodes as INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED; do not fabricate children. Detailed coverage requires a closed format mapping that is part of this named versioned normative algorithm or an explicitly identified versioned normative format mapping authorized under §34.3. Merely publishing an implementation descriptor does not authorize such semantics. The mapping must fix node kinds, source locators, ordering, exact canonical source values and child extraction. This insertion adds no format-specific adapter or mapping. A claim of supported detailed coverage without that normative mapping is blocked; genuinely unsupported formats retain the fallback below. A mechanically available subdivision cannot be suppressed or relabeled unsupported to avoid that blocker.

Subdivision is additive: an exact UTF-8 whole-file projection emits its physical spans even when a supported structured mapping also emits structural nodes and textual leaves. Whole-file spans, structural nodes and structural textual-leaf spans have distinct kinds and locators and are all counted; overlap in underlying bytes does not deduplicate these different accounting obligations. Each archive-member or embedded-file occurrence emits both its parent structural occurrence unit and its own child inventory unit, followed by its own supported content/subdivisions. A textual leaf is not a child file and gets no inventory unit. Repeated references to the same emitted unit still deduplicate under the rule below.

Source hashes and binding are closed as follows. C(x) means the exact UTF-8 bytes of §34.1 canonical JSON; H(b) means lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal of exact bytes b. Source-value hash preimages by kind are:

- ARTIFACT_INVENTORY: C({"byteLength":n,"contentSha256":h}), where n is exact byte length and h=H(exact artifact bytes). If bytes are unavailable, both values are null; asserted length/digest remains source context, never substituted for observed bytes. The unit remains inaccessible/blocked, with its retained occurrence/locator binding.

- PHYSICAL_SPAN: the exact original byte span including its terminator, without canonical JSON wrapping. Its locator binds zero-based byte start and exclusive end plus the one-based page/line coordinates.

- STRUCTURAL_NODE: C({"nodeKind":k,"status":q,"value":v}), where k and v are the exact kind and canonical source value fixed by the authorized format mapping, and q is ACCESSIBLE or INACCESSIBLE_OR_BLOCKED. Inaccessible nodes have v=null; exact exposed parent/locator and k remain bound. No invented serialization of an adapter object is permitted.

- STRUCTURAL_TEXT_SPAN: exact UTF-8 bytes of the mapped exact textual leaf's physical span, including its terminator. The authorized mapping identifies the leaf and its exact extraction; no silent whitespace normalization is allowed.

Each unit's binding hash preimage is C({"algorithm":"closed-loop-raw-units/1","inputVersion":V,"occurrence":O,"kind":K,"locator":L,"sourceValueSha256":S}). V is the exact owning input-version identity string; O is the ordered zero-based safe-integer path of supplied root and, where applicable, child-member occurrence indices; K is exactly one of the seven uppercase kinds above; S is the corresponding source-value hash. L is an ordered locator array: human units use [originating JSON pointer, one-based physical line] or [originating JSON pointer] for whole strings/scalars; inventories use []; whole-file spans use [startByte,endByte,page,line]; structural nodes use [normative format mapping ID, exact mapping locator]; structural textual spans append [startByte,endByte,page,line] to their structural-leaf locator. Byte offsets for a structural textual leaf refer to its exact UTF-8 extraction. The source-value hash alone does not identify the occurrence: binding hash plus retained input/source supplies the exact type, location and occurrence. These accounting hashes/locators are not §34.2 canonical record IDs. Distinct roots are numbered in retained source occurrence order, including separately supplied identical roots; a canonical mirror does not receive a second root number.

An image/media occurrence without a supported finer subdivision uses its inventory unit as its whole-media unit. A format with no supported mechanically available subdivision likewise uses its inventory unit as the whole-file fallback, with an explicit unsupported/unavailable-subdivision basis and the original bytes retained. These fallbacks neither prove inspection nor remove existing material uncertainty/blockers. Comments, annotations, tracked changes, metadata and embedded content are not discarded as nonsemantic.

Deduplicate only repeated accounting references to the same occurrence, kind, location and exact source-value hash. Never merge distinct supplied occurrences, even with identical hashes. Order and retained source identity determine stable accounting references; canonical record IDs still use §34.2. Count the entire resulting unit universe, including inventory, structural and inaccessible units, when applying the unchanged §6.5A limits. The raw-unit challenge condition is strictly greater than 500, not greater than or equal to 500; every other size-independent trigger remains effective.
